title: koeleria × simonkaii
intro: Koeleria × simonkaii, commonly known as a hybrid of Koeleria macrantha and Koeleria sylvatica, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Koeleria × simonkaii include its ability to exhibit antioxidant and antispasmodic properties, making it potentially useful in the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Koeleria × simonkaii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
